case_number: 2025 INSC 259; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2025 @ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.2146 OF 2024
summary: Multiple appeals involving service matter; disciplinary proceedings under focus; standard of proof in departmental inquiries is preponderance of probability; concurrent findings of guilt upheld; criminal acquittal does not ipso facto invalidate departmental action; inadequate reasoning in reversal by High Court; principle of finality in service disputes emphasized; dismissal of respondent from service upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned judgment set aside; dismissal of respondent reinstated.
